requirements.text: The thermal rating must be 1.5 or higher.

requirements.quote: Doors (Per Section) One For Rear Door and Two For Front panels.
requirements.text: Each section must have one rear door and two front panels.
Panels must be made of steel, either 1/8 inch or 11 gauge.

requirements.quote: Minimum Distance from Floor to Lowest Device Yes
requirements.text: There must be a minimum distance from the floor to the lowest device.

requirements.quote: Floor Sill Framing and Anchoring Channel Required
requirements.text: Channel framing and anchoring for the floor sill is required.
The external control cable entrance must be at the top.
Nameplates must be laminated phenolic and screw-on.

requirements.quote: Interior Lighting Controlled by Door Switch (Per Section) Yes
requirements.text: Interior lighting must be controlled by a door switch for each section.

requirements.quote: Each Section and Compartment Physically Separable
requirements.text: Each section and compartment must be physically separable.

requirements.quote: Available Power Supply Volts 125 VDC Volts 120/240 VAC Phases Single Wire 3 Frequency 60 Hz
requirements.text: The power supply must be 125 VDC or 120/240 VAC, single phase, 3-wire, 60 Hz.
The wire size must support a voltage rating of 600 volts.
Power circuits must use 8 AWG wire.
Control circuits must use 12 and 14 AWG wire.
Trip and close circuits must use 12 AWG wire.
CT circuits must use 10 AWG wire.
Instrument circuits must use 16 AWG shielded twisted pair wire.

requirements.quote: Outdoor Ambient Temp Range ‐30 to +120 Degrees Fahrenheit
requirements.text: The outdoor ambient temperature range must be -30 to +120°F.

requirements.quote: Indoor Ambient Temp Range 60‐80 Degrees Fahrenheit
requirements.text: The indoor ambient temperature range must be 60-80°F.
The altitude must be 420 feet.

requirements.quote: Seismic and wind loading per Ground Motion Site Classification Wind Exposure Category
requirements.text: Seismic and wind loading must comply with ground motion, site classification, and wind exposure category.
